name: zcode-token-meter-mac

plugins.name: zcode-token-meter-mac
plugins.description: Floating always-on-top macOS widget showing live ZCode token speed (tok/s or tok/min) and prompt-cache hit rate, read locally from ZCode's SQLite DB. No network, no telemetry.
